subject: Temporary access proposal while invoice validation completes
messages:
From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@healthlytics.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot paused — invoice under review, can we avoid timer expiration?

Hi Neha,

Quick one — finance here flagged our onboarding invoice as needing an additional line-item before they can route payment. Legal and procurement are on it, but they said processing may take up to a week. Our engineering team is in the middle of a data ingestion test and the sandbox timer is about to expire, which would interrupt their progress.

Can Redwood provision a short-term bridge so we can keep the pilot environment and API keys live while the invoice is validated? We don't want to lose momentum — a 5–7 day buffer or a small token top-up would be ideal. Happy to share the PO/invoice if that helps.

Thanks —
Sofia Ramos
Director of Platform Integrations
HealthLytics
sofia.ramos@healthlytics.com
+1 415-555-0198

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot paused — invoice under review, can we avoid timer expiration?

Hi Sofia —

Thanks for the heads-up and for attaching the invoice in your earlier note (I saved it to the ticket). We can absolutely help avoid disruption while your procurement clears the extra line-item.

Proposed options:
- Short-term token grant: 100k tokens, expires in 7 days (no additional charges until PO clears).
- 5-day sandbox hold: freeze the trial timer and maintain current API keys (recommended if engineering needs the exact session state).

I'll loop in Ben and Camila to confirm approvals and logistics. If you can send the PO number or attach the invoice file formally, that will speed finance verification.

Neha Kapoor

Subject: Re: Pilot paused — invoice under review, can we avoid timer expiration?

Neha —

Good to see Sofia's team making progress. Approve the short-term token grant as a make-good for HealthLytics to keep engineering momentum. Let's offer the 7-day 100k token grant and the 5-day sandbox hold as a pair — tokens first, then freeze if they ask for stateful preservation.

Finance note: we need a PO number or confirmation email to reconcile the credit on our side; Camila, can you drop a brief note to payments to expect PO # when it comes through?

Deal details for records: deal DL-2027-0892; HubSpot link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/892

Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Provisioned: 7-day 100k token grant + sandbox hold (conditional)

Hi Sofia —

Following Ben's sign-off, we've provisioned a temporary 100,000 token credit to your pilot account. Details:
- Credit amount: 100,000 tokens
- Valid: 2027-05-12 09:00 PDT through 2027-05-19 09:00 PDT
- Actions: Your current API keys remain active. If you reply confirming the PO number or attach the invoice copy, we will record the grant internally and instruct payments to reconcile the credit when finance completes validation.

If you need the sandbox state frozen instead (to preserve ongoing ingestion sessions), tell us and we'll convert the token grant to a 5-day environment hold; note that a hold requires a brief ticket and a quick verification step with procurement.

Attachments included for internal records: invoice_4592.pdf (as provided).

Links: HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/892 | Pilot keepalive guidelines: https://app.redwood.com/docs/pilot-keepalive-guidelines

Thanks — let me know which option you prefer.

Neha Kapoor
